testCases.title: PERF - High-Concurrency Multi-Facet Search Latency SLA under Peak Load
preconditions: InvenTree database seeded with 10,000+ Part records and 200+ Part Categories
k6 performance test runner configured with 100 Virtual Users (VUs)

steps.action: Warm up cache for 30s with 10 VUs hitting /api/part/ search endpoints
steps.expectedResult: Warm-up phase completes; response latency stabilizes under 500ms

steps.action: Ramp up to 100 VUs generating 500 RPS executing randomized multi-facet search queries for 4 minutes
steps.expectedResult: p95 latency <= 2,000ms; p99 latency <= 3,000ms; HTTP 200 status code on >= 99.9% of requests

steps.action: Assert error rate and database connection saturation metrics
steps.expectedResult: Error rate < 0.1%; zero HTTP 504 Gateway Timeouts; database connection pool does not exhaust

postConditions: System recovers to baseline idle latency (p95 < 150ms) within 30 seconds of ramp-down

testCases.title: PERF - Paginated Part Catalogue Read Throughput & Cache Efficiency
preconditions: k6 load test engine targeting GET /api/part/?limit=50

steps.action: Execute sustained 800 RPS workload of paginated catalogue requests for 3 minutes
steps.expectedResult: p50 latency <= 150ms; p95 latency <= 500ms across all paginated response envelopes

steps.action: Measure response payload transfer rates and serialization overhead
steps.expectedResult: Throughput >= 750 requests/second maintained without dropped connections

postConditions: Database CPU utilization remains below 70% during peak read load

testCases.title: PERF - Concurrent Category Tree Mutation & Lock Contention Under Parallel Writes
preconditions: Root category created for stress testing (ID 999)
50 parallel API workers initialized with mutating tokens

steps.action: Dispatch 50 concurrent POST requests to /api/part/category/ creating subcategories under parent 999
steps.expectedResult: All 50 categories created with HTTP 201 Created; zero deadlock exceptions (40001 / SQLITE_BUSY / Deadlock detected)

steps.action: Assert tree pathstring recalculation integrity and write latency
steps.expectedResult: p95 write latency <= 1,000ms; tree lineage correctly points to parent 999 for all 50 children

postConditions: Database table locks released cleanly; category hierarchy remains mathematically valid

testCases.title: PERF - Soak & Memory Stability Under Sustained Multi-Facet Queries
preconditions: Node and InvenTree application processes monitored with memory and connection telemetry hooks
Continuous 150 RPS background query load active

steps.action: Execute steady-state search and part retrieval traffic at 150 RPS continuously for 60 minutes
steps.expectedResult: System maintains consistent latency without performance degradation over the 60-minute duration

steps.action: Compare Resident Set Size (RSS) memory consumption between minute 5 and minute 60
steps.expectedResult: RSS memory growth <= 5% (demonstrating absence of ORM object or cache memory leaks)

steps.action: Verify database connection pool active vs idle connection counters
steps.expectedResult: Zero leaked connections; pool returns to baseline idle level upon test completion

postConditions: Zero memory leaks or zombie threads observed during soak run
